azure.claude.storage_private_link_all_ap.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when it has no private endpoint connections or any connection is not Approved. Unapproved or absent private connections leave the intended private access path unavailable.

azure.claude.storage_queue_classic_loggi.description: For a standard storage account’s queue service, FAIL is reported when any of the read, write, or delete classic log categories is not enabled. Missing queue classic records can hide unauthorized reads or destructive writes.
azure.claude.storage_queue_classic_loggi.pass_when: PASS when all three classic log categories are enabled.

azure.claude.storage_vnet_service_endpoi.fail_when: FAIL when networkAcls.defaultAction is not Deny or virtualNetworkRules is empty.

azure.claude.stream_analytics_job_loggin.description: For a Stream Analytics job, FAIL means no diagnostic setting has any enabled resource-log category. Its job events may be absent from diagnostic exports.

azure.claude.stream_analytics_job_loggin.fail_when: FAIL when no setting contains an enabled resource-log category.

azure.claude.subscription_diagnostic_set.fail_when: FAIL when the complete scoped inventory contains no subscription diagnostic setting.

azure.claude.synapse_workspace_exfiltrat.description: For a Synapse workspace, FAIL means managedVirtualNetworkSettings.preventDataExfiltration is absent or not true. The declared managed network does not enforce this exfiltration switch.

azure.claude.synapse_workspace_private_l.description: For a Synapse workspace, FAIL is reported when no private endpoint connection has Approved status. The workspace has no approved private network path.

azure.claude.synapse_workspace_private_l.fail_when: FAIL when no private endpoint connection has Approved status.

azure.claude.synapse_workspace_vulnerabi.description: For a Synapse workspace, FAIL is reported when no SQL vulnerability assessment has recurringScans.isEnabled true. SQL configuration drift and known weaknesses may go unscanned.

azure.claude.synapse_workspace_vulnerabi.fail_when: FAIL when no SQL vulnerability assessment has recurringScans.isEnabled true.

azure.claude.vm_antimalware_auto_upgrade.description: For a Windows VM, FAIL means no Microsoft.Azure.Security IaaSAntimalware extension has autoUpgradeMinorVersion true. ProvisioningState is not tested.

azure.claude.vm_backup_daily_retention_7.pass_when: PASS when daily retention is at least seven days.
azure.claude.vm_backup_daily_retention_7.fail_when: FAIL when its matched backup policy retains daily recovery points for fewer than seven days.
azure.claude.vm_backup_daily_retention_7.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM is unprotected or the policy has no daily schedule.

azure.claude.vm_backup_protected.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when the complete backup inventory has no protected VM item with its sourceResourceId. A lost or corrupted VM may have no Azure Backup restore point.
azure.claude.vm_backup_protected.pass_when: PASS when a protected item references the VM.
azure.claude.vm_backup_protected.fail_when: FAIL when the complete backup inventory has no protected VM item with its sourceResourceId.

azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_linux.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when a successfully provisioned DependencyAgentLinux extension is absent. Dependency telemetry for linux processes may be missing.

azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_linux.fail_when: FAIL when a successfully provisioned DependencyAgentLinux extension is absent.
azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_linux.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Windows.

azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_windows.pass_when: PASS when the required extension exists and reports Succeeded.
azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_windows.fail_when: FAIL when a successfully provisioned DependencyAgentWindows extension is absent.
azure.claude.vm_dependency_agent_windows.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Linux.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.description: For a VM, FAIL means no Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension reports provisioningState Succeeded. The predicate does not require a specific Guest Configuration type or extension name.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.pass_when: PASS when any Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension reports Succeeded.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.fail_when: FAIL when no Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension of type ConfigurationforLinux with a name ending AzurePolicyforLinux reports Succeeded.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM runs Windows.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when a successfully provisioned Windows Guest Configuration extension is absent. Windows guest policy compliance cannot be assessed.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.pass_when: PASS when a Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension of type ConfigurationforWindows with a name ending AzurePolicyforWindows reports Succeeded.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_exte.fail_when: FAIL when no Microsoft.GuestConfiguration extension of type ConfigurationforWindows with a name ending AzurePolicyforWindows reports Succeeded.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_mana.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when its Guest Configuration extension is installed but neither system nor user managed identity is assigned. Guest Configuration may lack the identity needed to report and remediate assigned policy.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_syst.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when its Guest Configuration extension is installed without a system-assigned identity. Guest Configuration may lack the identity needed to report and remediate assigned policy.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_syst.fail_when: FAIL when its Guest Configuration extension is installed without a system-assigned identity.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_syst.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the Guest Configuration extension is absent.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_user.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when a user-assigned identity exists with the extension but no system-assigned identity is present. Guest Configuration may lack the identity needed to report and remediate assigned policy.
azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_user.pass_when: PASS when both user and system identities are assigned.

azure.claude.vm_guest_configuration_user.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the Guest Configuration extension is absent or no user-assigned identity exists.

azure.claude.vm_jit_access.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no Defender just in time network access policy contains the VM ID. Management access may remain open without time bounded approval.
azure.claude.vm_jit_access.pass_when: PASS when a JIT policy lists the VM.
azure.claude.vm_jit_access.fail_when: FAIL when no Defender just in time network access policy contains the VM ID.

azure.claude.vm_linux_no_passwordless_ac.description: For a Linux virtual machine, FAIL is reported when no `PasswordPolicy_msid232` guest configuration assignment reports Compliant. Linux accounts without passwords can permit unauthenticated local access.

azure.claude.vm_nsg_internet_management_.description: For a virtual machine, FAIL is reported when a NIC or subnet NSG permits internet ingress on port 22, 3389, 53, 123, 161, 389, or 1900. Remote administration or amplification services may be exposed to internet hosts.

azure.claude.vm_nsg_internet_management_.fail_when: FAIL when a NIC or subnet NSG permits internet ingress on port 22, 3389, 53, 123, 161, 389, or 1900.

azure.claude.vmss_linux_ssh_keys.description: For the virtual machine scale set, FAIL means `properties.virtualMachineProfile.osProfile.linuxConfiguration.disablePasswordAuthentication` is false. Password based SSH remains possible on scale set instances.
azure.claude.vmss_linux_ssh_keys.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the scale set OS is Windows.

azure.claude.vmss_load_balancer_backend.description: For a virtual machine scale set, FAIL is reported when no NIC IP configuration declares a load balancer backend address pool. Scale set instances may lack the intended load balanced ingress path.
azure.claude.vmss_load_balancer_backend.pass_when: PASS when at least one backend pool ID is declared.
azure.claude.vmss_load_balancer_backend.fail_when: FAIL when no NIC IP configuration declares a load balancer backend address pool.

azure.claude.vmss_managed_disks.description: For a VM scale set, FAIL means the OS disk declares nonempty vhdContainers. A missing or malformed managedDisk declaration yields UNKNOWN, including on data disks.
azure.claude.vmss_managed_disks.pass_when: PASS when the OS and all data disks have managedDisk objects and the OS disk has no nonempty vhdContainers.
azure.claude.vmss_managed_disks.fail_when: FAIL when the OS disk has nonempty vhdContainers.

azure.claude.vmss_not_empty.description: For a virtual machine scale set, FAIL is reported when sku.capacity is zero. No instances can serve workload traffic at zero capacity.

azure.claude.vnet_gateway_entra_only.description: For a VPN gateway with point to site clients, FAIL is reported when vpnAuthenticationTypes contains anything other than the sole AAD value. Certificate or RADIUS sign in may bypass the intended Entra policy.
azure.claude.vnet_gateway_entra_only.pass_when: PASS when the authentication type list is exactly [AAD].
azure.claude.vnet_gateway_entra_only.fail_when: FAIL when vpnAuthenticationTypes contains anything other than the sole AAD value.
azure.claude.vnet_gateway_entra_only.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the gateway is not VPN or has no point to site authentication types.

azure.claude.vnet_gateway_no_basic_sku.description: For a virtual network gateway, FAIL means properties.sku.name is Basic. The check compares a reviewed SKU list; it does not inspect network exposure.
azure.claude.vnet_gateway_no_basic_sku.pass_when: PASS when `properties.sku.name` is `VpnGw1` or `VpnGw2` or `VpnGw3` or `VpnGw4` or `VpnGw5` or `VpnGw1AZ` or `VpnGw2AZ` or `VpnGw3AZ` or `VpnGw4AZ` or `VpnGw5AZ` or `Standard` or `HighPerformance` or `UltraPerformance` or `ErGw1AZ` or `ErGw2AZ` or `ErGw3AZ` or `ErGwScale`.

azure.claude.vnet_peering_connected.description: For a virtual network, FAIL is reported when any declared peering has peeringState Disconnected. Expected cross network routes may silently fail.
azure.claude.vnet_peering_connected.pass_when: PASS when no declared peering is Disconnected.
azure.claude.vnet_peering_connected.fail_when: FAIL when any declared peering has peeringState Disconnected.

azure.claude.waf_policy_bot_protection.description: For a WAF policy, FAIL is reported when no Microsoft_BotManagerRuleSet exists or a rule in that set is disabled. Automated abusive traffic may bypass the policy’s bot rules.
azure.claude.waf_policy_bot_protection.pass_when: PASS when a Bot Manager rule set exists with no disabled rules.
azure.claude.waf_policy_bot_protection.fail_when: FAIL when no Microsoft_BotManagerRuleSet exists or a rule in that set is disabled.

azure.claude.waf_policy_request_body_ins.description: For a WAF policy, FAIL means requestBodyCheck is false, so the policy is not configured to inspect request bodies.

azure.claude2.activity_log_alert_service.description: For a subscription, FAIL is reported when no enabled Service Health activity log alert covers the subscription. Operators may miss Azure service incidents that affect the subscription.
azure.claude2.activity_log_alert_service.pass_when: PASS when a matching enabled alert exists.
azure.claude2.activity_log_alert_service.fail_when: FAIL when no enabled Service Health activity log alert covers the subscription.
azure.claude2.activity_log_alert_service.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the anchor is not a subscription.

azure.claude2.aks_azure_monitor_metrics_.description: For an AKS cluster, FAIL is reported when azureMonitorProfile.metrics.enabled is absent or false. Cluster metrics may not reach Azure Monitor.
azure.claude2.aks_azure_monitor_metrics_.pass_when: PASS when the metrics profile exists with enabled true.
azure.claude2.aks_azure_monitor_metrics_.fail_when: FAIL when azureMonitorProfile.metrics.enabled is absent or false.

azure.claude2.aks_private_cluster_nodes_.description: For an AKS cluster, FAIL means it has no privateFQDN or no agent pool has node public IP disabled. The evaluator accepts one private node pool even when other pools expose public IPs.
azure.claude2.aks_private_cluster_nodes_.pass_when: PASS when privateFQDN is truthy and at least one agent pool has enableNodePublicIP false or omitted.
azure.claude2.aks_private_cluster_nodes_.fail_when: FAIL when privateFQDN is absent or false, or every agent pool has public node IP enabled.

azure.claude2.api_app_client_certificate.description: For an App Service API app, FAIL is reported when properties.clientCertEnabled is false. Requests can arrive without the configured client certificate gate.
azure.claude2.api_app_client_certificate.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_cors_no_wildcard.description: For an API app, FAIL means its configured CORS allowedOrigins list contains *. Missing CORS settings or an origin list without * pass.
azure.claude2.api_app_cors_no_wildcard.pass_when: PASS when CORS is absent or allowedOrigins does not contain *.
azure.claude2.api_app_cors_no_wildcard.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_ftps_required.description: For an App Service API app, FAIL is reported when configuration.properties.ftpsState is AllAllowed. Plain FTP can expose deployment credentials and content.
azure.claude2.api_app_ftps_required.pass_when: PASS when the state is FtpsOnly or Disabled.
azure.claude2.api_app_ftps_required.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_https_only.description: For an API app, FAIL means properties.httpsOnly is false, so HTTP requests are not redirected to HTTPS.
azure.claude2.api_app_https_only.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_managed_identity.description: For an App Service API app, FAIL is reported when identity.type is None or no identity is declared. The app may rely on long lived secrets to call Azure services.
azure.claude2.api_app_managed_identity.pass_when: PASS when a system or user assigned identity is declared.
azure.claude2.api_app_managed_identity.fail_when: FAIL when identity.type is None or no identity is declared.
azure.claude2.api_app_managed_identity.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_min_tls_12.description: For an API app, FAIL means the configured minimum inbound TLS version is below 1.2.
azure.claude2.api_app_min_tls_12.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element ending in api.

azure.claude2.api_app_remote_debugging_d.description: For an App Service API app, FAIL is reported when configuration.properties.remoteDebuggingEnabled is true. A remote debugger may expose process state and secrets.
azure.claude2.api_app_remote_debugging_d.pass_when: PASS when remote debugging is false.
azure.claude2.api_app_remote_debugging_d.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has no functionapp element and kind is exactly api.

azure.claude2.apim_consumption_client_ce.description: For a Consumption API Management service, FAIL is reported when properties.enableClientCertificate is absent or false. Clients may call APIs without presenting the configured certificate.
azure.claude2.apim_consumption_client_ce.fail_when: FAIL when properties.enableClientCertificate is absent or false.
azure.claude2.apim_consumption_client_ce.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the SKU is not Consumption.

azure.claude2.app_gateway_http2_enabled.description: For an Application Gateway, FAIL means enableHttp2 is false; clients cannot use HTTP/2 through its configured frontend.

azure.claude2.app_gateway_min_tls_12.description: For an Application Gateway, FAIL is reported when its configured custom or predefined SSL policy permits TLS 1.0 or 1.1. Older TLS clients can negotiate weaker transport protection.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_min_tls_12.pass_when: PASS when no SSL policy is set or its policy minimum is TLS 1.2 or 1.3.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_min_tls_12.fail_when: FAIL when its configured custom or predefined SSL policy permits TLS 1.0 or 1.1.

azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_enabled.description: For an Application Gateway, FAIL is reported when neither a firewallPolicy ID nor an enabled webApplicationFirewallConfiguration exists. HTTP attacks may reach backends without the declared WAF filter.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_enabled.pass_when: PASS when a firewall policy is attached or the inline WAF configuration is enabled.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_enabled.fail_when: FAIL when neither a firewallPolicy ID nor an enabled webApplicationFirewallConfiguration exists.

azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_mode_speci.description: For an Application Gateway, FAIL means neither an attached WAF policy nor inline WAF configuration exists. Detection and Prevention both pass when read from the attached policy or inline mode; Detection does not block requests.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_mode_speci.pass_when: PASS when the attached policy or inline configuration reports Detection or Prevention mode.
azure.claude2.app_gateway_waf_mode_speci.fail_when: FAIL when neither WAF policy nor inline WAF configuration exists; an unrecognized mode yields UNKNOWN.

azure.claude2.app_service_environment_in.description: For an App Service environment, FAIL is reported when clusterSettings lacks InternalEncryption with value true. Internal environment traffic or storage may lack the requested encryption setting.
azure.claude2.app_service_environment_in.pass_when: PASS when the InternalEncryption cluster setting is true.
azure.claude2.app_service_environment_in.fail_when: FAIL when clusterSettings lacks InternalEncryption with value true.

azure.claude2.app_service_plan_minimum_s.description: For an App Service plan, FAIL is reported when sku.name is F1, D1, B1, B2, or B3. The plan may lack higher tier isolation and capacity features.
azure.claude2.app_service_plan_minimum_s.pass_when: PASS when the SKU is outside those low tier names.
azure.claude2.app_service_plan_minimum_s.fail_when: FAIL when sku.name is F1, D1, B1, B2, or B3.

azure.claude2.app_workers_more_than_one.description: For an App Service site, FAIL means numberOfWorkers is one or fewer; it has no declared multiple-worker capacity.
azure.claude2.app_workers_more_than_one.pass_when: PASS when numberOfWorkers is greater than one.
azure.claude2.app_workers_more_than_one.fail_when: FAIL when numberOfWorkers is one or fewer.

azure.claude2.application_insights_confi.description: For a subscription, FAIL is reported when no Application Insights component appears in the complete scoped inventory. Application telemetry may be absent for incident triage.
azure.claude2.application_insights_confi.pass_when: PASS when at least one component is collected.
azure.claude2.application_insights_confi.fail_when: FAIL when no Application Insights component appears in the complete scoped inventory.
azure.claude2.application_insights_confi.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the subscription has no App Service or Functions app.

azure.claude2.application_insights_publi.description: For an Application Insights component, FAIL means public ingestion or public query access remains Enabled. Both declared access modes must be Disabled.
azure.claude2.application_insights_publi.pass_when: PASS when both ingestion and query public network access are Disabled.
azure.claude2.application_insights_publi.fail_when: FAIL when either publicNetworkAccessForIngestion or publicNetworkAccessForQuery is Enabled.

azure.claude2.application_insights_works.description: For the application insights, FAIL means `properties.WorkspaceResourceId` is null. Telemetry may lack the retention and access controls of a linked Log Analytics workspace.
azure.claude2.application_insights_works.pass_when: PASS when WorkspaceResourceId is a nonempty string.
azure.claude2.application_insights_works.fail_when: FAIL when WorkspaceResourceId is null or empty.

azure.claude2.automation_variable_encryp.description: For an Automation variable, FAIL means isEncrypted is false, so the variable is not marked for encrypted storage.

azure.claude2.batch_account_customer_man.description: For a Batch account, FAIL means encryption.keySource is Microsoft.Batch rather than Microsoft.KeyVault; no customer-managed key is declared.

azure.claude2.batch_account_managed_iden.description: For a Batch account, FAIL is reported when identity is absent, null, or has type None. The Batch account may need stored credentials for dependent Azure resources.
azure.claude2.batch_account_managed_iden.pass_when: PASS when identity.type is SystemAssigned or UserAssigned.
azure.claude2.batch_account_managed_iden.fail_when: FAIL when identity is absent, null, or has type None.

azure.claude2.batch_account_resource_log.description: For a Batch account, FAIL means no diagnostic setting has an enabled log entry with usable retention metadata. An enabled retention policy missing days does not count.
azure.claude2.batch_account_resource_log.pass_when: PASS when at least one setting has an enabled log entry that is not excluded by enabled retention with missing days.
azure.claude2.batch_account_resource_log.fail_when: FAIL when no eligible enabled log entry exists.

azure.claude2.defender_attack_path_setti.description: For a subscription, FAIL is reported when attack path alert setting or a matching alert notification contact is absent. Attack path findings may not be delivered to responders.
azure.claude2.defender_attack_path_setti.pass_when: PASS when attack path notifications and an alert contact are configured.
azure.claude2.defender_attack_path_setti.fail_when: FAIL when attack path alert setting or a matching alert notification contact is absent.
azure.claude2.defender_attack_path_setti.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the anchor is not a subscription or no AttackPath Defender setting exists.

azure.claude2.entra_ca_mfa_all_users_or_.description: For an Entra tenant, FAIL means no enabled Conditional Access policy requires MFA, excludes no users, and includes either All users or an activated directory role template.
azure.claude2.entra_ca_mfa_all_users_or_.pass_when: PASS when one enabled MFA policy has no excluded users and includes All users or at least one activated directory role template.
azure.claude2.entra_ca_mfa_all_users_or_.fail_when: FAIL when no policy meets all those conditions.
azure.claude2.entra_ca_mfa_all_users_or_.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_custom_banned_passwo.description: For the Entra tenant, this evaluates customized EnableBannedPasswordCheck directory setting values. FAIL when not every customized value parses true; an absent customization is NOT_APPLICABLE.
azure.claude2.entra_custom_banned_passwo.pass_when: PASS when every customized value parses true.
azure.claude2.entra_custom_banned_passwo.fail_when: FAIL when at least one does not satisfy the rule that every customized value parses true.
azure.claude2.entra_custom_banned_passwo.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when no directory setting customizes EnableBannedPasswordCheck. Also when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_device_join_requires.description: For the Entra tenant, FAIL means its unique device registration policy says MFA is notRequired for device join or registration.
azure.claude2.entra_device_join_requires.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_global_admin_between.description: For the Entra tenant, FAIL means fewer than two or more than four distinct principals have an active tenant-wide Global Administrator role assignment. Eligible PIM roles are not counted.
azure.claude2.entra_global_admin_between.pass_when: PASS when two to four distinct principals have active Global Administrator assignments at directoryScopeId /.
azure.claude2.entra_global_admin_between.fail_when: FAIL when the count of active Global Administrator role assignments is below two or above four.
azure.claude2.entra_global_admin_between.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_lockout_duration_min.description: For the Entra tenant, this evaluates customized LockoutDurationInSeconds directory setting values. FAIL when not every customized value is at least 60 seconds; an absent customization is NOT_APPLICABLE.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_duration_min.pass_when: PASS when every customized value is at least 60 seconds.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_duration_min.fail_when: FAIL when at least one does not satisfy the rule that every customized value is at least 60 seconds.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_duration_min.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when no directory setting customizes LockoutDurationInSeconds. Also when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_lockout_threshold_ma.description: For the Entra tenant, this evaluates customized LockoutThreshold directory setting values. FAIL when not every customized value is at most 10; an absent customization is NOT_APPLICABLE.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_threshold_ma.pass_when: PASS when every customized value is at most 10.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_threshold_ma.fail_when: FAIL when at least one does not satisfy the rule that every customized value is at most 10.
azure.claude2.entra_lockout_threshold_ma.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when no directory setting customizes LockoutThreshold. Also when directory facts belong to a different tenant.

azure.claude2.entra_user_mfa_registered.description: For a user registration detail with a principal name, FAIL means isMfaRegistered is false; no MFA method is recorded for that user.
azure.claude2.entra_user_mfa_registered.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when Upstream skips registration rows without a user principal name.

azure.claude2.function_app_authenticatio.description: For an App Service function app, FAIL is reported when authSettingsV2.properties.platform.enabled is false or omitted. Unauthenticated callers can reach app endpoints if no other gate exists.
azure.claude2.function_app_authenticatio.pass_when: PASS when the authentication platform switch is true.
azure.claude2.function_app_authenticatio.fail_when: FAIL when authSettingsV2.properties.platform.enabled is false or omitted.
azure.claude2.function_app_authenticatio.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element.

azure.claude2.function_app_client_certif.description: For an App Service function app, FAIL is reported when properties.clientCertEnabled is false. Requests can arrive without the configured client certificate gate.
azure.claude2.function_app_client_certif.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element.

azure.claude2.function_app_ftps_required.description: For an App Service function app, FAIL is reported when configuration.properties.ftpsState is AllAllowed. Plain FTP can expose deployment credentials and content.
azure.claude2.function_app_ftps_required.pass_when: PASS when the state is FtpsOnly or Disabled.
azure.claude2.function_app_ftps_required.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element starting with functionapp.

azure.claude2.function_app_linux_http2.description: For a Linux function app, FAIL means http20Enabled is false, so the endpoint is not configured for HTTP/2.
azure.claude2.function_app_linux_http2.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated functionapp element and a linux element.

azure.claude2.function_app_managed_ident.description: For an App Service function app, FAIL is reported when identity.type is None or no identity is declared. The app may rely on long lived secrets to call Azure services.
azure.claude2.function_app_managed_ident.pass_when: PASS when a system or user assigned identity is declared.
azure.claude2.function_app_managed_ident.fail_when: FAIL when identity.type is None or no identity is declared.
azure.claude2.function_app_managed_ident.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element and kind has a comma-separated element starting with functionapp.

azure.claude2.function_app_restrict_publ.description: For a function app, FAIL means a site access restriction explicitly allows ipAddress Any. An absent restriction list passes this predicate.
azure.claude2.function_app_restrict_publ.pass_when: PASS when no restriction has both ipAddress Any and action Allow, including when the list is absent.
azure.claude2.function_app_restrict_publ.fail_when: FAIL when at least one restriction has ipAddress Any and action Allow.
azure.claude2.function_app_restrict_publ.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind has a functionapp element.

azure.claude2.iam_no_custom_owner_roles.description: For a subscription, FAIL means a custom role definition declares * or *:* in its actions. The evaluator does not account for notActions or effective assignment.
azure.claude2.iam_no_custom_owner_roles.pass_when: PASS when no custom role declares * or *:* in actions.
azure.claude2.iam_no_custom_owner_roles.fail_when: FAIL when any custom role declares * or *:* in actions.
azure.claude2.iam_no_custom_owner_roles.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the anchor is not a subscription.

azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_configured.description: For an NSG attached to a subnet or NIC, FAIL is reported when neither a direct NSG flow log nor an enabled covering VNet flow log exists. Network traffic to the NSG may have no flow record.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_configured.pass_when: PASS when a direct flow log or enabled covering VNet log exists.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_configured.fail_when: FAIL when neither a direct NSG flow log nor an enabled covering VNet flow log exists.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_configured.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the NSG has no subnet or NIC attachment.

azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_retention_90.description: For an NSG with direct NSG flow logs, FAIL means any direct log is disabled or retains fewer than 90 days. Without direct logs, covering VNet logs pass when enabled with at least 90 days or zero for indefinite retention.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_retention_90.pass_when: PASS when direct logs meet 90 days, or covering VNet logs meet their 90 day or unlimited zero rule.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_retention_90.fail_when: FAIL when any direct NSG flow log is disabled or retains fewer than 90 days; when no direct log exists, a covering VNet log fails its 90 day or unlimited zero retention rule.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_log_retention_90.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when neither a direct NSG log nor covering VNet log is present.

azure.claude2.nsg_flow_logs_to_log_analy.description: For a subscription containing an NSG or VNet, FAIL means no NSG, VNet or NIC flow log has Traffic Analytics enabled with a Log Analytics workspace ID.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_logs_to_log_analy.pass_when: PASS when at least one targeted NSG, VNet or NIC flow log has enabled Traffic Analytics and a workspace ID.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_logs_to_log_analy.fail_when: FAIL when no such targeted flow log exists.
azure.claude2.nsg_flow_logs_to_log_analy.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the subscription inventory has neither NSGs nor VNets.

azure.claude2.prowler_app_authentication.description: For an App Service site whose kind starts with app, FAIL means App Service Authentication platform.enabled is false or omitted.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_authentication.pass_when: PASS when App Service Authentication platform.enabled is true.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_authentication.fail_when: FAIL when platform.enabled is false or omitted.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_authentication.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with app.

azure.claude2.prowler_app_client_certifi.description: For an App Service app, FAIL is reported when clientCertEnabled is false or clientCertMode differs from Required. Clients may access the app without presenting a certificate.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_client_certifi.pass_when: PASS when client certificates are enabled with mode Required.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_client_certifi.fail_when: FAIL when clientCertEnabled is false or clientCertMode differs from Required.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_client_certifi.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with app.

azure.claude2.prowler_app_http_logs.description: For an App Service site whose kind starts with app, FAIL means no diagnostic setting enables AppServiceHTTPLogs or the allLogs category group.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_http_logs.pass_when: PASS when any setting enables AppServiceHTTPLogs or allLogs.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_http_logs.fail_when: FAIL when no setting enables either log category or group.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_http_logs.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with app.

azure.claude2.prowler_app_identity.description: For an App Service app whose kind starts with app, FAIL is reported when identity.type is None or identity is absent. The app may rely on persistent secrets to access Azure services.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_identity.pass_when: PASS when a system or user managed identity is assigned.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_identity.fail_when: FAIL when identity.type is None or identity is absent.
azure.claude2.prowler_app_identity.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with app.

azure.claude2.prowler_function_ftp_ftps_.description: For a function app whose kind starts with functionapp, FAIL means ftpsState is FtpsOnly or AllAllowed; only Disabled turns off both FTP and FTPS publishing.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_ftp_ftps_.fail_when: FAIL when ftpsState is FtpsOnly or AllAllowed.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_ftp_ftps_.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with functionapp.

azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity.description: For a function app whose kind starts with functionapp, FAIL is reported when identity.type is None or identity is absent. The function may rely on persistent secrets to access Azure services.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity.pass_when: PASS when a system or user managed identity is assigned.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity.fail_when: FAIL when identity.type is None or identity is absent.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the site does not satisfy: kind starts with functionapp.

azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity_.description: For a function app with a managed identity, FAIL is reported when its principal has a subscription visible Owner, Contributor, User Access Administrator, or RBAC Administrator role assignment. Compromise of the function may grant broad Azure control.
azure.claude2.prowler_function_identity_.pass_when: PASS when none of those role definitions is assigned to its principal.

azure.port.storage_account_access_keys_p.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when either key1 or key2 creation timestamp is more than 90 days before context.created_at. An old shared key may remain usable after exposure.
azure.port.storage_account_access_keys_p.pass_when: PASS when both key creation timestamps are at most 90 days old.
azure.port.storage_account_access_keys_p.fail_when: FAIL when either key1 or key2 creation timestamp is more than 90 days before context.created_at.

azure.port.storage_account_blob_and_cont.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when either blob or container soft delete is disabled or has retention outside 7 through 365 days. Deleted blobs or containers may lack usable recovery points.
azure.port.storage_account_blob_and_cont.pass_when: PASS when both delete policies are enabled with 7 through 365 retention days.
azure.port.storage_account_blob_and_cont.fail_when: FAIL when either blob or container soft delete is disabled or has retention outside 7 through 365 days.

azure.port.storage_account_blob_soft_del.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when its blob service deleteRetentionPolicy is disabled or its retention is outside 7 through 365 days. Deleted blob data may become unrecoverable too soon.
azure.port.storage_account_blob_soft_del.pass_when: PASS when deleteRetentionPolicy is enabled with 7 through 365 retention days.
azure.port.storage_account_blob_soft_del.fail_when: FAIL when its blob service deleteRetentionPolicy is disabled or its retention is outside 7 through 365 days.

azure.port.storage_account_blob_versioni.description: For the storage account, FAIL means `storage_service[].data.properties.isVersioningEnabled` is false.

azure.port.storage_account_container_sof.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when its blob service containerDeleteRetentionPolicy is disabled or its retention is outside 7 through 365 days. Deleted container data may become unrecoverable too soon.
azure.port.storage_account_container_sof.pass_when: PASS when containerDeleteRetentionPolicy is enabled with 7 through 365 retention days.
azure.port.storage_account_container_sof.fail_when: FAIL when its blob service containerDeleteRetentionPolicy is disabled or its retention is outside 7 through 365 days.

azure.port.storage_account_encryption_at.description: For a storage account, FAIL means encryption.keySource is Microsoft.Storage rather than Microsoft.Keyvault. The check does not say that platform at-rest encryption is absent.

azure.port.storage_account_file_share_sm.description: For a storage account file service, FAIL means its SMB channel encryption string is not exactly AES-256-GCM;; a list containing that value alongside others still fails.
azure.port.storage_account_file_share_sm.pass_when: PASS when channelEncryption is exactly AES-256-GCM;.
azure.port.storage_account_file_share_sm.fail_when: FAIL when channelEncryption is any other recognized provider string.

azure.port.storage_account_file_share_sm.description: For a storage account file service, FAIL means its SMB protocol version string is not exactly SMB3.1.1;; a list containing that value alongside others still fails.
azure.port.storage_account_file_share_sm.pass_when: PASS when versions is exactly SMB3.1.1;.
azure.port.storage_account_file_share_sm.fail_when: FAIL when versions is any other recognized provider string.

azure.port.storage_account_geo_redundant.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when sku.name is outside Standard_GRS, Standard_RAGRS, Standard_GZRS, and Standard_RAGZRS. A regional outage may make the storage account unavailable without a geo replica.
azure.port.storage_account_geo_redundant.pass_when: PASS when the SKU is one of those geo redundant variants.
azure.port.storage_account_geo_redundant.fail_when: FAIL when sku.name is outside Standard_GRS, Standard_RAGRS, Standard_GZRS, and Standard_RAGZRS.

azure.port.storage_account_key_rotation_.description: For a storage account, FAIL means keyPolicy is absent or keyExpirationPeriodInDays is not exactly 90. This is a reminder setting; actual key regeneration is a separate check.
azure.port.storage_account_key_rotation_.pass_when: PASS when the key policy specifies exactly 90 days.
azure.port.storage_account_key_rotation_.fail_when: FAIL when keyPolicy is absent or the configured days differ from 90.

azure.port.storage_account_soft_delete_e.description: For the storage account, FAIL means `storage_service[].data.properties.deleteRetentionPolicy.enabled` is false.

azure.port.storage_account_trusted_micro.description: For a storage account, FAIL means its recognized networkAcls.bypass declaration omits AzureServices; trusted Azure services are not on the network bypass list.
azure.port.storage_account_trusted_micro.pass_when: PASS when the recognized bypass string includes AzureServices.
azure.port.storage_account_trusted_micro.fail_when: FAIL when the recognized bypass string omits AzureServices.

azure.sql.audit_retention.description: For a SQL audit policy, FAIL means retentionDays is positive but below 90. Zero means unlimited retention and passes.
azure.sql.audit_retention.pass_when: PASS when retentionDays is 0 or at least 90.

azure.sql.auditing.description: For the SQL audit policy, FAIL means `properties.state` is `Disabled`.

azure.sql.minimum_tls.description: For the sql server, FAIL means `properties.minimalTlsVersion` is `1.0`.

azure.sql.no_public_network.description: For the sql server, FAIL means `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is `Enabled`.

azure.sql.restrict_firewall.description: For an Azure SQL firewall rule, FAIL means its IPv4 range spans 0.0.0.0 through 255.255.255.255. A 0.0.0.0-only rule returns MANUAL because it means Allow Azure services.
azure.sql.restrict_firewall.pass_when: PASS for a valid IPv4 range other than the full internet range or the 0.0.0.0-only special rule.
azure.sql.restrict_firewall.fail_when: FAIL when startIpAddress is 0.0.0.0 and endIpAddress is 255.255.255.255.

azure.sql.tde_enabled.description: For the SQL database TDE policy, FAIL means `properties.state` is `Disabled`.
azure.sql.tde_enabled.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the parent database is master.

azure.sql.threat_alerts_all.description: For a SQL security alert policy, FAIL means disabledAlerts contains any nonempty category name, so that alert category is excluded.
azure.sql.threat_alerts_all.pass_when: PASS when disabledAlerts is empty or contains only empty strings.
azure.sql.threat_alerts_all.fail_when: FAIL when disabledAlerts contains at least one nonempty string.

azure.sql.threat_detection.description: For the SQL security policy, FAIL means `properties.state` is `Disabled`.

azure.storage.blob_soft_delete_retention.description: For a blob service, FAIL means soft delete is disabled or its retentionDays is outside 7 through 365.
azure.storage.blob_soft_delete_retention.pass_when: PASS when blob soft delete is enabled and days is 7 through 365.
azure.storage.blob_soft_delete_retention.fail_when: FAIL when blob soft delete is disabled or days is outside 7 through 365.
azure.storage.blob_soft_delete_retention.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the storage service is not blobServices.

azure.storage.blob_versioning.description: For a blob service, FAIL means properties.isVersioningEnabled is false, so blob object versioning is disabled.
azure.storage.blob_versioning.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the storage service is not blobServices.

azure.storage.container_soft_delete.description: For a blob service, FAIL means properties.containerDeleteRetentionPolicy.enabled is false, so container soft delete is disabled.
azure.storage.container_soft_delete.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the storage service is not blobServices.

azure.storage.cross_tenant_replication.description: For the storage account, FAIL means `properties.allowCrossTenantReplication` is true. Object replication can be configured across tenant boundaries.

azure.storage.default_deny.description: For the storage account, FAIL means `properties.networkAcls.defaultAction` is `Allow`. Unlisted clients may be admitted by the default storage network rule.

azure.storage.default_oauth.description: For a storage account, FAIL means defaultToOAuthAuthentication is false. The setting controls the default authentication choice; it does not itself disable shared keys.

azure.storage.https_only.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when properties.supportsHttpsTrafficOnly is false. HTTP requests can transfer storage data without TLS.

azure.storage.infrastructure_encryption.description: For a storage account, FAIL means requireInfrastructureEncryption is false, so the additional infrastructure encryption layer is not required.

azure.storage.minimum_tls.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when properties.minimumTlsVersion is TLS1_0 or TLS1_1. Clients can negotiate obsolete TLS versions.
azure.storage.minimum_tls.fail_when: FAIL when properties.minimumTlsVersion is TLS1_0 or TLS1_1.

azure.storage.no_blob_public_access.description: For a storage account, FAIL is reported when properties.allowBlobPublicAccess is true. Containers may be configured for anonymous blob reads.

azure.storage.no_public_network.description: For the storage account, FAIL means `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is `Enabled`.

azure.storage.no_shared_key.description: For the storage account, FAIL means `properties.allowSharedKeyAccess` is true. Shared account keys can bypass per-identity authorization and auditing.

azure.vault.approved_private_endpoint.description: For a Key Vault, FAIL is reported when networkAcls.defaultAction is Allow or no private endpoint is Approved. Unapproved private connectivity may leave the vault reachable only through unintended network paths.
azure.vault.approved_private_endpoint.pass_when: PASS when the ACL action is Deny and at least one private endpoint is Approved.
azure.vault.approved_private_endpoint.fail_when: FAIL when networkAcls.defaultAction is Allow or no private endpoint is Approved.

azure.vault.default_deny.description: For the Key Vault, FAIL means `properties.networkAcls.defaultAction` is `Allow`. Unlisted network sources may reach the vault endpoint.

azure.vault.no_public_network.description: For the Key Vault, FAIL means `properties.publicNetworkAccess` is `Enabled`.

azure.vault.purge_protection.description: For the Key Vault, FAIL means `properties.enablePurgeProtection` is false. An attacker with deletion rights may permanently purge vault objects.

azure.vault.rbac.description: For the Key Vault, FAIL means `properties.enableRbacAuthorization` is false. Legacy vault access policies may be changed outside Azure RBAC governance.

azure.vault.secret_expiration.description: For an enabled Key Vault secret, FAIL is reported when properties.attributes.exp is null. A secret without expiry can remain usable indefinitely.
azure.vault.secret_expiration.pass_when: PASS when a positive expiration timestamp is present.
azure.vault.secret_expiration.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the secret is disabled.

azure.vault.soft_delete.description: For the Key Vault, FAIL means `properties.enableSoftDelete` is false.

azure.vm.encryption_at_host.description: For a VM, FAIL means encryptionAtHost is false, so host encryption is not declared for temporary disks and caches.

azure.vm.linux_ssh_keys.description: For the virtual machine, FAIL means `properties.osProfile.linuxConfiguration.disablePasswordAuthentication` is false. Password based SSH remains permitted on the Linux VM.
azure.vm.linux_ssh_keys.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the VM OS is Windows.

azure.vm.managed_disks.description: For a VM with a persistent OS disk, FAIL means an OS or data disk has an explicit null managedDisk or an unmanaged VHD object. Missing storage-type metadata yields UNKNOWN.
azure.vm.managed_disks.pass_when: PASS when its persistent OS and data disks are managed.
azure.vm.managed_disks.fail_when: FAIL when any OS or data disk has an explicit null managedDisk or an unmanaged VHD object.
azure.vm.managed_disks.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the OS disk is ephemeral with diffDiskSettings.option Local.

azure.vm.trusted_launch.description: For a virtual machine with securityType TrustedLaunch, FAIL is reported when secureBootEnabled or vTpmEnabled is false. A Trusted Launch VM with a disabled switch lacks the corresponding boot integrity protection.
azure.vm.trusted_launch.pass_when: PASS when both UEFI switches are true; Standard and ConfidentialVM security types also pass without this test.
azure.vm.trusted_launch.fail_when: FAIL when secureBootEnabled or vTpmEnabled is false.
